FULL TEXT:
Department of Food Science & Technology
(NAAC Accredited Grade – A+)
University of Kashmir, Hazratbal Srinagar-190 006.
No: (Advertisement/SSL/JKDST) FST/KU/2026
Date: 01.04.2026
Advertisement and Extension Notice
Applications are invited for the 01 position of Semi Skilled Labour under the
Government of Jammu & Kashmir Department of Science & Technology
sanctioned project implemented by the Department of Food Science & Technology,
University of Kashmir.
Position: Semi Skilled Labour (01)
Eligibility:
 Candidates must have know-how of the apple orchard work.
 Understandig of basic agricultural tasks.
 Having relevant experience in agricultural/field work.
Nature of Work:
 Assistance in project-related laboratory and field activities.
 Support in handling materials, sample preparation, and orchard-related work.
Duration: 02 years, the position is temporary and co-terminus with the
project.
Salary: Negotiable
How to Apply:
Interested candidates may submit their application along with relevant documents to
the office of the:Department of Food Science & Technology, University of
Kashmir, Srinagar – 190006, on or before 8th April 2026.
Important Note:
The last date for submission of applications for the earlier advertised position of
Junior Project Fellow (JPF) under the same project vide advertisement No:
(Advertisement/JKDST ) FST/KU/2026, Dated: 09-03-2026 is also extended up to
08th April 2026.
Dr. Adil Gani
Principal Investigator
